# measured date

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:measuredDate`](gmeow-measuredDate.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/measuredDate>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

The absolute date instant yielded by a temporal measurement. Semantically plays the [`observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) role for [`TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md), but is NOT asserted as [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) because [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) ([gufo:AbstractIndividual](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#AbstractIndividual)) is not a subclass of [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) ([gufo:Endurant](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Endurant)), the range of [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md). Projection-layer alignment to [time:hasTime](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#hasTime) lives in the mapping DSL.
